items.title: Eddie Alley interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002
items.q: Well I hired Vince Guaraldi, when he first started out he didn’t have anything, and he thanked me later, he said, “Eddie, you helped me out when I really needed help.” He was a heck of a piano player. So he played with me. He played with my little outfit.

ctx.x: Well he played the piano player. Well I hired Vince Guaraldi, when he first started out he didn’t have anything, and he thanked me later, he said, “Eddie, you helped me out when I really needed help.” He was a heck of a piano player. So he played with me. He played with my little outfit. I had some good musicians that played with me. That’s the thing right there.
How long did you have this band for?
